text: Found it. A woken session starts in a fresh container with an empty /tmp, so the chat watcher re-printed every old message that had no reply and the session answered them again. Fixed in tools/chat_watch.sh: it now skips messages older than 24 h, and ones an earlier watcher already showed unless they are under 30 min old. Old requests are already in TASKS.md, so nothing is lost. Takes effect for the next session that wakes.
